title: Geaux Yella - Scared For
htmlContent: [caption id="attachment_2364" align="aligncenter" width="267"] Processed with VSCO with hb2 preset[/caption] There is no shame in Geaux Yella's game and this week he watches over his "Pull Up" visual with the SWAC-directed "Scared For", a business-as-usual, typical 'day in the life' affair. Well, for Baton Rouge anyway Regardless, the recent El Jeffe Music Group signee and former Kevin Gates affiliate is about ready to lace us all with a huge dose of "KHOcaine", the name of Yella's forthcoming project.
